title: Scoring API error logs include sanitized failure diagnostics
description:
The pre-commit security audit intentionally removed user-controlled scoring IDs and exception text from log messages (log-injection / information-exposure mitigation). The HTTP response sanitization in plexus/workers/scoring_api.py is correct and must stay, but the server-side warning log now records only the status code. Operators can no longer correlate a failed request with a scoring job or see which resource was missing.

Restore operator diagnostics in server logs using injection-safe encoding (strip/escape newlines, or structured log fields) while keeping HTTP responses sanitized. Also: the generic handler binds an unused exception variable (`except Exception as exc:`), and consider letting self-authored static 4xx validation messages (e.g. 'scorecard is required') pass through to callers since they are not internal state.

```gherkin
Feature: Scoring API failure diagnostics
  Scenario: Known scoring failure is traceable in server logs
    Given a scoring request that references a missing resource
    When POST /v1/score returns a sanitized 4xx response
    Then the server log records the failure reason and a request correlation identifier in injection-safe form

  Scenario: Responses remain sanitized
    Given a scoring request that fails unexpectedly
    When the API responds
    Then the response body contains no internal exception text
```

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Progress: implemented injection-safe scoring API failure diagnostics. Error responses remain sanitized, and the API now emits a server-generated request_id in error responses and logs so operators can correlate failures without logging user-controlled identifiers. Known scoring failures log status_code plus a constant reason_code; unexpected failures log request_id without request-derived fields. Validation passed: focused API tests, py_compile, git diff --check, and rcql with --scan-files for plexus/workers/scoring_api.py returned Total: 0.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Review finding during close-out verification: scoring_error_reason_code derives the reason from string-matching the error message. Two defects confirmed empirically: (1) score-not-found messages contain the word 'scorecard', so they always classify as scorecard_not_found; (2) user-controlled identifiers inside messages can flip the code (a scorecard named with 'item' in it classifies as item_not_found), which reintroduces user influence over the logged diagnostic. Fix in progress: carry an explicit reason_code on ScoringJobError set at each raise site, with a status-code-only fallback, removing message string-matching entirely. Failing spec first per The Way.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Verified and completed. Codex implementation reviewed: server-generated request_id correlates sanitized error responses with logs, responses contain no internal exception text, unused exception binding removed, and log-line coverage exists including a log-injection attempt case. One defect found during review and fixed: the reason-code classifier string-matched user-influenced message text, so score-not-found always classified as scorecard_not_found and identifiers containing 'item' could flip the code. Fixed by carrying an explicit constant reason_code on ScoringJobError at each raise site with a status-code-only fallback; no message parsing remains. Spec-first: new failing tests for content-independent reason codes were added and confirmed red before the fix. Validation: 23 focused tests pass (workers, Helm render, seeder), py_compile clean, git diff --check clean.
